text:
Avery: Heads-up — LuminaryHealth flagged as high-risk at renewal. Usage down 42% month-over-month, onboarding checklist 60% complete. Renewal in 27 days.
Priya: Ugh. Which modules are lagging?
Avery: Core inference pipelines and tokenization integration. They tried a pilot on Dedicated but revert rate on SDK calls is high. Said engineers are blocked on the sample bundling step.
Marco: Got it. I can run a short 'bootcamp' next week: 2 sessions (dev deep-dive + exec value sync). Will need product + solutions presence.
Lena: I can do the executive value sync and bring adoption metrics slide. Can we get a quick action plan?
Avery: Plan proposal: 
1) Immediate concierge call (this week) to unblock SDK bundling — Marco
2) Two-day Bootcamp (dev + exec) within 10 days — Marco + Lena
3) Success plan with adoption KPIs and a 14-day health check — Priya
4) If no lift by day 20, offer a temporary promo + extended support window to avoid downgrade — Devon
Priya: I'll draft the success plan and KPIs. Need a ready-to-send email and a short enablement checklist. Anyone have a lightweight template?
Devon: Use the quick save email we used for BrightMetro but shorten. Also propose: one-hour office hours for their engineers for 7 days post-bootcamp.
Marco: For the dev session, I want to include this snippet to illustrate bundling fix:
```
# quick fix for sample bundling
import redwood_sdk
client = redwood_sdk.Client(api_key=...)
client.bundle_samples(path="./samples", model="redwood-13b")
```
Avery: Perfect. Can someone drop the office-hours cadence (slots) into a calendar invite template?
Lena: I'll author the invite + exec deck. Ping @cs-bot for the playbook link and the saved email template.
cs-bot: Playbook "retention-mini-bootcamp-v1" found — https://redwood.tools/playbooks/retention-mini-bootcamp-v1 :link: 
Priya: Drafted email below (short):
"Hi <contact>, we saw usage drop and want to run a targeted 2-day bootcamp to unblock your team. Marcos (eng) will lead a dev session and Lena (CSM) will run an exec sync. Can we confirm Tue/Wed next week? We’ll provide office hours and a tailored success plan"
Avery: Love it. Minor edit: change 'Marcos' -> 'Marco' and mention the 14-day health check.
Priya: Updated and ready.
Devon: Who owns the promo decision if they still slip? Need approvals.
Avery: I'll pre-authorize a 20% credit and extended support for one billing cycle if KPIs not met and product signs off. @Marco please validate cost impact quickly.
Marco: I’ll triage — shouldn't be material.
Lena: Next steps checklist for ops: 
• Avery sends the concierge invite today.
• Marco sets dev session agenda + sample code.
• Priya sends email to customer after invite scheduled.
• Devon prepares promo terms and approval thread.
• Lena readies exec slide deck.
Avery: Thanks team — aim to have the invite scheduled within 12 hours. Will update thread when booked. :thumbsup:
Marco: I'm free for office hours Fri 10–12 EST and Mon 14–16 EST.
Priya: Submitted email to <account@luminaryhealth.com> and scheduled the concierge call for today 4pm PT.
Avery: Booked. Added follow-up reminders and the playbook link in the calendar.
Lena: Deck drafted and shared in the #cs-drive folder.
Devon: Promo pre-approved by finance for up to one billing cycle. Keeping us flexible.
Avery: Fantastic. Will loop back after the concierge call with a short runbook and P0 blockers.
Priya: If anyone wants the enablement checklist I iterated, I’ll drop it here after the call.
Lena: Thanks all — big effort but high upside on this renewal. :rocket:
